description:
FILED s514e (Opus, 2026-10-10).  Attribute::Handlers (core) does not transpile: "Parser2 TODO: oversized top-level my extent: %global_phases not promotable".  Attribute/Handlers.pm declares `my %global_phases = (...)` and `my @global_phases = qw(...)` at file level, both captured by named subs; the promotion refuses a FAMILY of one bare name (two containers named global_phases) in one extent.  This is the last blocker of t/op/attrhand.t (4 planned, 0 run, "Failed to transpile Handlers.pm") now that `attributes` itself works (s514e, #3162) -- Attribute::Handlers is built on MODIFY_CODE_ATTRIBUTES, which PCL now dispatches.  Reproducer: `my %g = (a => 1); my @g = (1); sub f { $g{a} . $g[0] } print f(), "\n";` in a file large enough to force promotion (or any module that runs the same path) -- perl "11".


CORRECTION (probed): the two-line family reproducer above WORKS in PCL (prints 11) -- the refusal needs the FORCED (oversized-extent) promotion path; the reproducer is `perl -e 'use Attribute::Handlers; print 1'` -> PCL dies at transpile with the message above.
subject: Attribute::Handlers does not transpile: file-level %global_phases + @global_phases family refused by promotion (t/op/attrhand.t)
